title: The Free Fall
desc: The Free Fall is a deeply personal horror thriller, a mind bending pressure cooker that constantly challenges us, hurling us towards one of the most shocking cinematic reveals imaginable. After attempting to take her own life, a young woman must wrestle with an overbearing husband and the only way out of this hell, is to fall into it.

title: Maneater
desc: While the group of friends explore a beautiful small island, all hell breaks loose for Jessie as the rogue shark sets its hunting grounds within the vicinity. A Father with a score to settle brings his war to their doorstep.

title: Wrecker
desc: Two beautiful young women taking a trip through the countryside, are terrorized by an unknown driver trying to run them down in a heavy duty tow truck.

title: Orphan First Kill
desc: After orchestrating a brilliant escape from an Estonian psychiatric facility, Esther travels to America by impersonating the missing daughter of a wealthy family. Yet, an unexpected twist arises that pits her against a mother who will protect her family from the murderous "child" at any cost.

title: Room 203
desc: Many residents of ROOM 203 have disappeared since the murder suicide of a married couple exactly fifty years ago. Lifelong friends Kim and Izzy and roommates are terrified by the vengeful spirits dwelling in their apartment. To save Izzy's life, Kim may need to sacrifice her own. Based on the Internationally Bestselling novel by Kamon Nanami.

title: The Descent Part 2
desc: Refusing to believe her story about cave-dwelling monsters, the sole survivor of a spelunking exploration gone horribly wrong is forced to follow the authorities back into the caves where something awaits. The trapped group soon faces the hunger and savage breed of predators while trying to find a way out.

title: Redline
desc: Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.
